text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate ONE newly designed fictional adult male, 22-26, for a 28-character casting library. IMPORTANT: build the NEW facial geometry explicitly specified below. Do not reproduce any of the reference photographs or previous generated portraits in the conversation. References are only conceptual inspiration for mood, hair category and wardrobe. These must be recognizably different people, not small face edits or clones. Retain attractive youthful natural charm without extreme fashion-model sculpting.
Consistent art direction: genuinely photographic, natural matte skin with subtle pores and uneven coloring, modest facial asymmetry, natural unglossed lips, no oil sheen or wet hair, no waxy CGI skin, no beauty filter, no exaggeration or illustration. Neutral soft daylight studio illumination, restrained contrast and neutral color. Solid opaque clean WHITE backdrop. Normal believable anatomy.
Composition: individual vertical 3:4 portrait, head completely inside frame with 6% clear headroom, mid-torso crop, 85mm eye-level portrait, face crisp, relaxed shoulders, arms naturally down. No hand near face, no handheld objects of ANY kind, no phone, helmet in hand, controller, stick, pole, drink, accessories held in hands. Wearable glasses / hats / headphones permitted ONLY if specified. No furniture, no environments, no text, numbers, branding, watermark or collage.
CHARACTER 14: Absorbed but friendly gamer. Dense black curls and deep brown eyes. NEW face: full round cheeks, medium wide nose, lighter eyebrows, small matte lips and subtle ear asymmetry. Black tee and gray over-ear headphones. No controller or other objects.
